experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1190:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6056:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:8559:我找到了最初的 single-support kill-switch 说明：原始建议里其实有 “best 至少追回 >=2 mAP”，这比脚本现在的 `best-worst > 3` 更接近 support 选择价值，但仍然要和 random/one-positive 控制分开。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1191:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6057:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:8583:  6008	- few-shot / mixed data：CFReID、ReMix 说明少样本/混合单摄像头数据已有先例，但“标准监督 ReID 中强制 single-support 表征学习”仍有空白。来源：[CFReID](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.18469)、[ReMix](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.21938)
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1192:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6058:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:8588:  6013	1. **Single-Support CVaR Episodic Loss**
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1193:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6059:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:8589:  6014	核心：训练时每个 ID 只允许一个 support 图代表身份，query 必须从这个单图 support 中恢复身份边界；再对最差 support 选择做 CVaR/worst-case 优化。它直接回应 `single-image support incomplete`，不是测试侧，也不是范式重定义，最终仍输出常规 ReID descriptor。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1194:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6060:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:8593:  6018	第一步 kill-switch：零训练。用现有 checkpoint 做 single-support gallery probe：每个 gallery ID 只留 1 张图，分别报 random-support / worst-support / best-support / full-gallery mAP。若 random 或 worst 比 full 掉 >3 mAP，且 best-support 能追回 >=2 mAP，说明 support 选择是真瓶颈。否则 kill。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1195:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6061:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:8609:  6034	4. **Natural Camera-Pose Subgroup CVaR**
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1196:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6062:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:8619:  6044	下一步最务实：先做候选 1 的零训练 single-support probe。它最贴合 `exp109` 根问题，且不需要新依赖、不改 batch size、不碰测试侧。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1197:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6063:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:8630:  6055	- few-shot / mixed data：CFReID、ReMix 说明少样本/混合单摄像头数据已有先例，但“标准监督 ReID 中强制 single-support 表征学习”仍有空白。来源：[CFReID](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.18469)、[ReMix](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.21938)
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1198:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6064:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:8635:  6060	1. **Single-Support CVaR Episodic Loss**
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1199:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6065:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:8636:  6061	核心：训练时每个 ID 只允许一个 support 图代表身份，query 必须从这个单图 support 中恢复身份边界；再对最差 support 选择做 CVaR/worst-case 优化。它直接回应 `single-image support incomplete`，不是测试侧，也不是范式重定义，最终仍输出常规 ReID descriptor。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1200:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6066:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:8640:  6065	第一步 kill-switch：零训练。用现有 checkpoint 做 single-support gallery probe：每个 gallery ID 只留 1 张图，分别报 random-support / worst-support / best-support / full-gallery mAP。若 random 或 worst 比 full 掉 >3 mAP，且 best-support 能追回 >=2 mAP，说明 support 选择是真瓶颈。否则 kill。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1201:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6067:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:8883:`eval_gallery` 和仓库标准 `utils.metrics.eval_func` 的核心 AP 公式一致：排序后去掉 same pid+cam，再按剩余 cross-cam positive 算 AP/R1。不同点是这里用 `qf @ gf.T` 当相似度，仓库默认评测常见是 Euclidean；只有 cache 特征已 L2-normalized 且 full-gallery sanity 对齐 exp260b 时才可接受。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1202:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6068:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:9008:/bin/zsh -lc "find . -name '*ae_feats*' -o -name '*single_support*' -o -name '*exp367*' | sed -n '1,120p'" in /Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1203:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6069:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:9010:./experiments/exp367_single_support
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1204:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6070:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:9011:./experiments/exp367_single_support/cvpb_single_support_probe.py
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1205:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6071:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:9018:- **High** [cvpb_single_support_probe.py:41](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/cvpb_single_support_probe.py:41): `eval_gallery` 对“固定 gallery”是标准 Market 过滤：排 same pid + same cam，再算 AP/R1。问题是 single-support 会制造“该 query 没有跨 cam positive”的情况，line 45 会直接跳过 query。这样 best/worst 可能比较的是不同 query 子集，不是同一任务难度。应报告 `n_valid_q`，并考虑 missing-positive 记 0，或固定 common-valid query mask。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1206:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6072:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:9020:- **High** [cvpb_single_support_probe.py:51](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/cvpb_single_support_probe.py:51): 每个 `pid` 只留 1 张会把 Market 的 distractor-only / no-query pid 也压成 1 张。若 cache 里有 `pid=0` 或其它 gallery-only ID，负样本池被大幅削弱，`#false-in-topk` 会变，single-support mAP 不能和 full-gallery 直接解释。no-query/distractor pid 应保持全量，或单独做等负样本数控制。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1207:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6073:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:9022:- **High** [cvpb_single_support_probe.py:85](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/cvpb_single_support_probe.py:85): kill-switch 条件 `worst-full drop >3 && best-worst >3` 还不够干净。`worst-full drop` 很容易混入“少正样本/换负样本池/跳过无 positive query”的 trivial 变化；`best-worst gap` 比 full-drop 更有意义，因为两边都是单 support，但仍受 valid-query 覆盖和负样本池变化影响。建议主判据改成 `best-random`、`random-worst` 多 seed 均值/std，并控制 `#false-in-topk` / top1 margin。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1208:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6074:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:9024:- **Medium** [cvpb_single_support_probe.py:62](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/cvpb_single_support_probe.py:62): best/worst 选择逻辑作为“positive support quality oracle”基本对：同 ID query、按候选 support 相似度均值、排 same cam。但它不是严格的 best/worst retrieval AP oracle，因为没看 distractor、margin、false positives；且用 query label 做 oracle，只能当诊断上/下界，不能直接证明训练时可学到 support 选择。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1209:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6075:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:9026:- **Medium** [cvpb_single_support_probe.py:26](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/cvpb_single_support_probe.py:26): `/tmp/ae_feats.npz` 复用只有在 provenance 明确时才可接受。当前机器这个文件不存在；脚本也没校验 keys、shape、feature norm、finite、q/g 数量、ckpt/config/hash、full-gallery mAP sanity。并且若是 exp260b Base cache，就不能直接当 exp030a/Swin-Tiny 主线证据。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1210:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6076:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:9028:- **Low** [cvpb_single_support_probe.py:57](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/cvpb_single_support_probe.py:57): random-support 只跑 seed=42，不能作为判据基准。至少 20-100 seeds 报均值/std。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1211:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6077:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:9042:- **High** [cvpb_single_support_probe.py:41](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/cvpb_single_support_probe.py:41): `eval_gallery` 对“固定 gallery”是标准 Market 过滤：排 same pid + same cam，再算 AP/R1。问题是 single-support 会制造“该 query 没有跨 cam positive”的情况，line 45 会直接跳过 query。这样 best/worst 可能比较的是不同 query 子集，不是同一任务难度。应报告 `n_valid_q`，并考虑 missing-positive 记 0，或固定 common-valid query mask。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1212:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6078:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:9044:- **High** [cvpb_single_support_probe.py:51](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/cvpb_single_support_probe.py:51): 每个 `pid` 只留 1 张会把 Market 的 distractor-only / no-query pid 也压成 1 张。若 cache 里有 `pid=0` 或其它 gallery-only ID，负样本池被大幅削弱，`#false-in-topk` 会变，single-support mAP 不能和 full-gallery 直接解释。no-query/distractor pid 应保持全量，或单独做等负样本数控制。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1213:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6079:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:9046:- **High** [cvpb_single_support_probe.py:85](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/cvpb_single_support_probe.py:85): kill-switch 条件 `worst-full drop >3 && best-worst >3` 还不够干净。`worst-full drop` 很容易混入“少正样本/换负样本池/跳过无 positive query”的 trivial 变化；`best-worst gap` 比 full-drop 更有意义，因为两边都是单 support，但仍受 valid-query 覆盖和负样本池变化影响。建议主判据改成 `best-random`、`random-worst` 多 seed 均值/std，并控制 `#false-in-topk` / top1 margin。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1214:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6080:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:9048:- **Medium** [cvpb_single_support_probe.py:62](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/cvpb_single_support_probe.py:62): best/worst 选择逻辑作为“positive support quality oracle”基本对：同 ID query、按候选 support 相似度均值、排 same cam。但它不是严格的 best/worst retrieval AP oracle，因为没看 distractor、margin、false positives；且用 query label 做 oracle，只能当诊断上/下界，不能直接证明训练时可学到 support 选择。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1215:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6081:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:9050:- **Medium** [cvpb_single_support_probe.py:26](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/cvpb_single_support_probe.py:26): `/tmp/ae_feats.npz` 复用只有在 provenance 明确时才可接受。当前机器这个文件不存在；脚本也没校验 keys、shape、feature norm、finite、q/g 数量、ckpt/config/hash、full-gallery mAP sanity。并且若是 exp260b Base cache，就不能直接当 exp030a/Swin-Tiny 主线证据。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1392:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6282:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_smoke.md:3151:experiments/exp367_single_support/monitor.md:25:codex 调研 Single-Support CVaR 训练设计 + novelty 确认（63517）：episodic 单图 support + CVaR worst-case 如何写 loss、避六点定律陷阱（不塑造/对齐/压缩变体）、cheap 验证路径（frozen head 小训 or full FT）。GO 则训练侧创新动手，full fine-tune 前 codex 三审 diff。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1395:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6285:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_smoke.md:3154:experiments/exp367_single_support/design.md:11:ReID 训练用 multi-shot gallery（每 ID 多图），但模型学到的身份边界可能依赖"见过该 ID 多个 view"。部署常 single-shot（单图 support 定义新身份）。训练时**强制单图 support + CVaR worst-support 优化**，逼模型学"从任意单图恢复完整身份边界"的鲁棒表征，而非依赖 multi-view 平均。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:1466:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:6356:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_smoke.md:3225:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_smoke.md:1071:ReID 训练用 multi-shot gallery（每 ID 多图），但模型学到的身份边界可能依赖"见过该 ID 多个 view"。部署常 single-shot（单图 support 定义新身份）。训练时**强制单图 support + CVaR worst-support 优化**，逼模型学"从任意单图恢复完整身份边界"的鲁棒表征，而非依赖 multi-view 平均。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:5886:**根因**: **resnet50 调出来的峰值 LR(3.5e-4 AdamW 均一施加到 ~50M 参数 SOLIDER Swin transformer)对 Swin 过大 → warmup 升过 ~2.5e-4 时几步大更新把 backbone 推进"常数输出"退化吸引子**。resnet50 不塌(对它 3.5e-4 安全), 仓库主 SOLIDER config 训 Swin 用 SGD BASE_LR=8e-4 + 20-epoch warmup(对 transformer 等效步长温和得多)。这是 LR 问题, 不是 AMP/forward 问题(AMP 仅可能放大, 但 LR 是触发器; 全程无 inf/scale 警告)。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_11.md:808:`TEST.IMS_PER_BATCH 64` 建议都加上，因为测试集大、又开了翻转测试时，默认 256 容易把显存撑爆。后台跑用 `setsid nohup python train.py ... </dev/null > /path/uniq.log 2>&1 &`。日志文件名必须唯一，不要互相覆盖。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_11.md:900:出现 NaN 或 Inf，立刻停，先查原因，再决定是降学习率还是回退。显存溢出时，先减小模块复杂度，或者把 `TEST.IMS_PER_BATCH` 调小，不要随便改训练 batch size。长时间没进展时，先把证据写下来，再决定要不要停。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_20.md:547:出现 NaN 或 Inf，立刻停，先查原因，再决定是降学习率还是回退。显存溢出时，先减小模块复杂度，或者把 `TEST.IMS_PER_BATCH` 调小，不要随便改训练 batch size。长时间没进展时，先把证据写下来，再决定要不要停。

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3287:experiments/cargo_cvpb/monitor.md:151:**根因**: **resnet50 调出来的峰值 LR(3.5e-4 AdamW 均一施加到 ~50M 参数 SOLIDER Swin transformer)对 Swin 过大 → warmup 升过 ~2.5e-4 时几步大更新把 backbone 推进"常数输出"退化吸引子**。resnet50 不塌(对它 3.5e-4 安全), 仓库主 SOLIDER config 训 Swin 用 SGD BASE_LR=8e-4 + 20-epoch warmup(对 transformer 等效步长温和得多)。这是 LR 问题, 不是 AMP/forward 问题(AMP 仅可能放大, 但 LR 是触发器; 全程无 inf/scale 警告)。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:12274:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:13348:experiments/exp343_pose_guided_clip/claude_review.md:67:- **Low-2 (config 死设置，无害但误导)**：exp343/exp341 都设了 `POSE_TEST_FEAT: 'equal_concat'`，但 clip-only 路径**没有任何部位分支**会去读它——`self.pose_test_feat` 属性在 `__init__` 仅于部位分支 if 块内赋值（line 168/187/235/279/333），clip-only 下从不赋值；eval 端用 `getattr(self,'pose_test_feat','global')` 回退到 `'global'`，且所有 `use_*` 为 False 使每个 elif 跳过。故该设置**完全不被读取**，最终 eval 必为 GAP global。无功能影响，但字面误导（像在用 LGPA 的 equal_concat）。建议把它改成 `'global'` 或删除以免日后误读。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:12278:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:13581:experiments/exp349b_small_undetach_clip/claude_review.md:82:- **风险点不在训练而在 eval**：config TEST.IMS_PER_BATCH=256（line 77）。按项目铁律（experiment_protocol.md），所有训练启动必须 CLI override **`TEST.IMS_PER_BATCH 64`**，否则 384×128 + flip-test TTA 在 e80 fragmentation 下历史上 OOM 过两次。⚠️ **启动命令务必加 `TEST.IMS_PER_BATCH 64`**（这是流程要求，config 本身保留 256 可接受，但启动必须 override）。

experiments/exp349b_small_undetach_clip/claude_review.md:82:- **风险点不在训练而在 eval**：config TEST.IMS_PER_BATCH=256（line 77）。按项目铁律（experiment_protocol.md），所有训练启动必须 CLI override **`TEST.IMS_PER_BATCH 64`**，否则 384×128 + flip-test TTA 在 e80 fragmentation 下历史上 OOM 过两次。⚠️ **启动命令务必加 `TEST.IMS_PER_BATCH 64`**（这是流程要求，config 本身保留 256 可接受，但启动必须 override）。
experiments/exp349b_small_undetach_clip/claude_review.md:98:逐行核对了 clip_id_loss 在 LGPA+GCN dual 分支的注入与透传（model line 733/747-749 → processor line 1297）、parallel_aug 4-view 下的单次计数（view0 only + loss_fn 不读 clip_id）、Swin-Small in_planes=768 与 clip_id_proj 维度匹配、OA-SD EMA 深拷贝对冻结 CLIP 的恒等性、两次 CLIP 加载（ViT-B-32 buffer vs ViT-L-14 子模块）无 key 冲突、PLBOA 正交、单变量隔离（仅 POSE_CLIP_ID_PROMPT）。未发现 Critical/High 阻断项。唯一硬性提醒：**启动训练命令必须 `TEST.IMS_PER_BATCH 64` override**（流程铁律，防 eval OOM）。其余为 Low 级继承自 exp341 的已验证项。

experiments/exp018/design.md:21:- 需要确保 PoseBackboneModel 在 `POSE_BACKBONE_PSG: False` 时不创建 PSG 模块但仍支持 PCG
experiments/exp018/design.md:24:PCG 目前在 `PoseBackboneModel` 中实现，而 `PoseBackboneModel` 只在 `POSE_BACKBONE_PSG: True` 时被实例化。如果关闭 PSG，需要将 PCG 移到基础模型中，或者保持 `POSE_BACKBONE_PSG: True` 但清空 `psg_stage_indices`。
experiments/exp018/design.md:26:**方案**: 使用 `POSE_BACKBONE_PSG: True`（加载 PoseBackboneModel），但设置 `POSE_PSG_STAGES: []`（空列表，不创建任何 PSG 模块），同时开启 `POSE_CHANNEL_GATE: True`。这样 backbone 照常运行（无 PSG 注入），但 GAP 后有 PCG。

experiments/exp341_clip_id_prompt/claude_review.md:65:6. **SupCon i2t/t2i**：L2-norm 双方 → `a@b.t()/temp` → same-label mask → `-(mask*logsoftmax).sum(1)/mask.sum(1).clamp(min=1)` → mean。对称双向 `supcon(img,txt)+supcon(txt,img)`。`text_feat[i]` 是 `labels[i]` 的原型（per-sample txt_proto = clip_id_prompt(label)，与 image 同序），正样本经 label mask 选取，包含 batch 内同 ID 多实例（NUM_INSTANCE=4）→ 标准 CLIP-ReID stage1 SupCon ✓。`mask.sum>=1`（对角自身恒为正）→ 不会除零 ✓。
experiments/exp341_clip_id_prompt/claude_review.md:82:- **R1 — LR schedule 与 CoOp 不匹配**：CoOp prompt 通常用较高的**常数** LR（原论文 SGD 0.002 cosine，但 prompt 单独高 LR）。本 config 让 `cls_ctx` 跟 SOLIDER backbone 同一套（BASE_LR=0.0008，20 epoch warmup→cosine 衰减），warmup 早期 LR 极小，prompt 可能学得慢/学不动。**这是 tuning 风险不是 bug**：若 clip_id_loss 不降或 global 不涨，第一件事就是给 `cls_ctx`/`clip_id_proj` 单独抬 LR（可仿 make_optimizer.py:20 的 part_lr_factor 加一个 clip-id 分支，或 LARGE_FC_LR 思路）。建议训练时把 `details['clip_id']` 打进 log 盯它是否单调下降——日志已接（processor.py:1301），够观察。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:8477:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:12274:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:13348:experiments/exp343_pose_guided_clip/claude_review.md:67:- **Low-2 (config 死设置，无害但误导)**：exp343/exp341 都设了 `POSE_TEST_FEAT: 'equal_concat'`，但 clip-only 路径**没有任何部位分支**会去读它——`self.pose_test_feat` 属性在 `__init__` 仅于部位分支 if 块内赋值（line 168/187/235/279/333），clip-only 下从不赋值；eval 端用 `getattr(self,'pose_test_feat','global')` 回退到 `'global'`，且所有 `use_*` 为 False 使每个 elif 跳过。故该设置**完全不被读取**，最终 eval 必为 GAP global。无功能影响，但字面误导（像在用 LGPA 的 equal_concat）。建议把它改成 `'global'` 或删除以免日后误读。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:6584:**根因**: **resnet50 调出来的峰值 LR(3.5e-4 AdamW 均一施加到 ~50M 参数 SOLIDER Swin transformer)对 Swin 过大 → warmup 升过 ~2.5e-4 时几步大更新把 backbone 推进"常数输出"退化吸引子**。resnet50 不塌(对它 3.5e-4 安全), 仓库主 SOLIDER config 训 Swin 用 SGD BASE_LR=8e-4 + 20-epoch warmup(对 transformer 等效步长温和得多)。这是 LR 问题, 不是 AMP/forward 问题(AMP 仅可能放大, 但 LR 是触发器; 全程无 inf/scale 警告)。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:13348:experiments/exp343_pose_guided_clip/claude_review.md:67:- **Low-2 (config 死设置，无害但误导)**：exp343/exp341 都设了 `POSE_TEST_FEAT: 'equal_concat'`，但 clip-only 路径**没有任何部位分支**会去读它——`self.pose_test_feat` 属性在 `__init__` 仅于部位分支 if 块内赋值（line 168/187/235/279/333），clip-only 下从不赋值；eval 端用 `getattr(self,'pose_test_feat','global')` 回退到 `'global'`，且所有 `use_*` 为 False 使每个 elif 跳过。故该设置**完全不被读取**，最终 eval 必为 GAP global。无功能影响，但字面误导（像在用 LGPA 的 equal_concat）。建议把它改成 `'global'` 或删除以免日后误读。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/evidence_method_design.md:203:**根因**: **resnet50 调出来的峰值 LR(3.5e-4 AdamW 均一施加到 ~50M 参数 SOLIDER Swin transformer)对 Swin 过大 → warmup 升过 ~2.5e-4 时几步大更新把 backbone 推进"常数输出"退化吸引子**。resnet50 不塌(对它 3.5e-4 安全), 仓库主 SOLIDER config 训 Swin 用 SGD BASE_LR=8e-4 + 20-epoch warmup(对 transformer 等效步长温和得多)。这是 LR 问题, 不是 AMP/forward 问题(AMP 仅可能放大, 但 LR 是触发器; 全程无 inf/scale 警告)。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:1076:experiments/exp341_clip_id_prompt/claude_review.md:82:- **R1 — LR schedule 与 CoOp 不匹配**：CoOp prompt 通常用较高的**常数** LR（原论文 SGD 0.002 cosine，但 prompt 单独高 LR）。本 config 让 `cls_ctx` 跟 SOLIDER backbone 同一套（BASE_LR=0.0008，20 epoch warmup→cosine 衰减），warmup 早期 LR 极小，prompt 可能学得慢/学不动。**这是 tuning 风险不是 bug**：若 clip_id_loss 不降或 global 不涨，第一件事就是给 `cls_ctx`/`clip_id_proj` 单独抬 LR（可仿 make_optimizer.py:20 的 part_lr_factor 加一个 clip-id 分支，或 LARGE_FC_LR 思路）。建议训练时把 `details['clip_id']` 打进 log 盯它是否单调下降——日志已接（processor.py:1301），够观察。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:3854:experiments/cargo_cvpb/monitor.md:151:**根因**: **resnet50 调出来的峰值 LR(3.5e-4 AdamW 均一施加到 ~50M 参数 SOLIDER Swin transformer)对 Swin 过大 → warmup 升过 ~2.5e-4 时几步大更新把 backbone 推进"常数输出"退化吸引子**。resnet50 不塌(对它 3.5e-4 安全), 仓库主 SOLIDER config 训 Swin 用 SGD BASE_LR=8e-4 + 20-epoch warmup(对 transformer 等效步长温和得多)。这是 LR 问题, 不是 AMP/forward 问题(AMP 仅可能放大, 但 LR 是触发器; 全程无 inf/scale 警告)。

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:1831:experiments/exp341base_noprompt/claude_review.md:82:- **R1 — LR schedule 与 CoOp 不匹配**：CoOp prompt 通常用较高的**常数** LR（原论文 SGD 0.002 cosine，但 prompt 单独高 LR）。本 config 让 `cls_ctx` 跟 SOLIDER backbone 同一套（BASE_LR=0.0008，20 epoch warmup→cosine 衰减），warmup 早期 LR 极小，prompt 可能学得慢/学不动。**这是 tuning 风险不是 bug**：若 clip_id_loss 不降或 global 不涨，第一件事就是给 `cls_ctx`/`clip_id_proj` 单独抬 LR（可仿 make_optimizer.py:20 的 part_lr_factor 加一个 clip-id 分支，或 LARGE_FC_LR 思路）。建议训练时把 `details['clip_id']` 打进 log 盯它是否单调下降——日志已接（processor.py:1301），够观察。

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3287:experiments/cargo_cvpb/monitor.md:151:**根因**: **resnet50 调出来的峰值 LR(3.5e-4 AdamW 均一施加到 ~50M 参数 SOLIDER Swin transformer)对 Swin 过大 → warmup 升过 ~2.5e-4 时几步大更新把 backbone 推进"常数输出"退化吸引子**。resnet50 不塌(对它 3.5e-4 安全), 仓库主 SOLIDER config 训 Swin 用 SGD BASE_LR=8e-4 + 20-epoch warmup(对 transformer 等效步长温和得多)。这是 LR 问题, 不是 AMP/forward 问题(AMP 仅可能放大, 但 LR 是触发器; 全程无 inf/scale 警告)。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage2.md:8165:- **Critical** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:248): `make_optimizer(cfg, model)` 调用错误。项目实现是 `make_optimizer(cfg, model, center_criterion)`，并返回 `(optimizer, optimizer_center)`，见 [make_optimizer.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/solver/make_optimizer.py:4)。当前会直接 `TypeError`，训练无法启动。应改成保留 `center_criterion` 并解包 optimizer。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage2.md:8167:- **High** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:287): `scheduler.step()` 少传 `epoch`。当前 `create_scheduler` 返回的项目 scheduler 要求 `step(epoch)`，见 [scheduler.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/solver/scheduler.py:67)，标准 processor 也是 `scheduler.step(epoch)`。修完 optimizer 后会在 epoch 1 结束崩。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage2.md:8169:- **Medium** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:220): 评估口径只保留 full/random/worst，没有 probe v2 的 best-support、best-worst gap、random/worst false10 输出。核心 mAP 计算、common-valid、distractor 全量、missing-positive=0 是对的，但证据链弱于 [probe v2](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/cvpb_single_support_probe.py:101)，不够支撑“gap 缩小/false10 非 trivial”判断。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage2.md:8171:- **Low** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:84): 解冻范围确实覆盖 `base.stages[-1] + bottleneck + classifier`，但会把原本冻结的 BNNeck bias 重新设成可训练；原始模型显式 `bottleneck.bias.requires_grad_(False)`，见 [make_model.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/model/make_model.py:237)。另外 Swin 的 `base.norm3` 在 `stages[-1]` 外，仍被冻结，严格说不是完整 last-stage 输出层 FT。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage2.md:8173:- **Low** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:154): `call_project_loss` 捕获所有 `TypeError` 后静默降级，可能掩盖 loss 内部真实 bug。当前项目 `make_loss` 支持 `kp_data`，正常不会触发，但这里最好只做显式签名兼容或直接调用。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage2.md:8188:- **Critical** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:248): `make_optimizer(cfg, model)` 调用错误。项目实现是 `make_optimizer(cfg, model, center_criterion)`，并返回 `(optimizer, optimizer_center)`，见 [make_optimizer.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/solver/make_optimizer.py:4)。当前会直接 `TypeError`，训练无法启动。应改成保留 `center_criterion` 并解包 optimizer。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage2.md:8190:- **High** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:287): `scheduler.step()` 少传 `epoch`。当前 `create_scheduler` 返回的项目 scheduler 要求 `step(epoch)`，见 [scheduler.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/solver/scheduler.py:67)，标准 processor 也是 `scheduler.step(epoch)`。修完 optimizer 后会在 epoch 1 结束崩。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage2.md:14829:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:18958:- **Critical** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:248): `make_optimizer(cfg, model)` 调用错误。项目实现是 `make_optimizer(cfg, model, center_criterion)`，并返回 `(optimizer, optimizer_center)`，见 [make_optimizer.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/solver/make_optimizer.py:4)。当前会直接 `TypeError`，训练无法启动。应改成保留 `center_criterion` 并解包 optimizer。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage2.md:14830:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:18960:- **High** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:287): `scheduler.step()` 少传 `epoch`。当前 `create_scheduler` 返回的项目 scheduler 要求 `step(epoch)`，见 [scheduler.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/solver/scheduler.py:67)，标准 processor 也是 `scheduler.step(epoch)`。修完 optimizer 后会在 epoch 1 结束崩。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage2.md:14831:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:18962:- **Medium** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:220): 评估口径只保留 full/random/worst，没有 probe v2 的 best-support、best-worst gap、random/worst false10 输出。核心 mAP 计算、common-valid、distractor 全量、missing-positive=0 是对的，但证据链弱于 [probe v2](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/cvpb_single_support_probe.py:101)，不够支撑“gap 缩小/false10 非 trivial”判断。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage2.md:14851:- **High** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:170): eval 特征抽取和 probe v2 不完全同口径。probe v2 的 `/tmp/ae_feats.npz` 来源是 `POSE_TEST_FEAT=global + TEST.NECK_FEAT=after + pose_dict=None` 的 pose-OFF global BNNeck 特征；当前脚本只临时设 `pose_test_feat='global'`，但 `POSE_ENABLED=True` 时仍传 `pose_dict`，且不强制 `NECK_FEAT='after'`。如果要和 `94.43 / 73.36 / 63.82` 这组 probe v2 baseline 比，当前数字不可直接比较。要么强制 eval pose-off + after，要么先用当前 pose-on/before-or-after 口径重跑 baseline。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage2.md:14855:- **Medium** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:269): `ss_episode_loss` 在 AMP autocast 内运行，`F.normalize + einsum / tau + cross_entropy` 可能走半精度。默认 `tau=0.1` 正常大概率没事，但 collapse/近零范数时半精度 normalize 更容易出 NaN。更稳是 episode loss 内部显式用 `feat.float()` 或在该段禁用 autocast。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:18958:- **Critical** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:248): `make_optimizer(cfg, model)` 调用错误。项目实现是 `make_optimizer(cfg, model, center_criterion)`，并返回 `(optimizer, optimizer_center)`，见 [make_optimizer.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/solver/make_optimizer.py:4)。当前会直接 `TypeError`，训练无法启动。应改成保留 `center_criterion` 并解包 optimizer。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:18960:- **High** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:287): `scheduler.step()` 少传 `epoch`。当前 `create_scheduler` 返回的项目 scheduler 要求 `step(epoch)`，见 [scheduler.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/solver/scheduler.py:67)，标准 processor 也是 `scheduler.step(epoch)`。修完 optimizer 后会在 epoch 1 结束崩。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:18962:- **Medium** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:220): 评估口径只保留 full/random/worst，没有 probe v2 的 best-support、best-worst gap、random/worst false10 输出。核心 mAP 计算、common-valid、distractor 全量、missing-positive=0 是对的，但证据链弱于 [probe v2](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/cvpb_single_support_probe.py:101)，不够支撑“gap 缩小/false10 非 trivial”判断。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:18966:- **Low** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:154): `call_project_loss` 捕获所有 `TypeError` 后静默降级，可能掩盖 loss 内部真实 bug。当前项目 `make_loss` 支持 `kp_data`，正常不会触发，但这里最好只做显式签名兼容或直接调用。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage3.md:5822:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage2.md:5811:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:8757:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:6004:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:570:experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:129:        raise RuntimeError("single-support CVaR needs NUM_INSTANCE >= 2")
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage3.md:6794:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage2.md:14853:- **Medium** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:129): CVaR 训练目标仍是 batch 内 P 类分类，默认 `IMS_PER_BATCH=64, K=4 => P=16`，没有 gallery distractor。前面 frozen smoke 已证明 N=16 episode loss 几乎为 0；last-stage 可能再次出现 `ss_ce/ss_cvar` 很小，导致 cvar≈random，不能真验机制。不是 runtime bug，但实验解释风险高。至少启动前应把 `ss_ce/ss_cvar/top-tail risk` 作为止损监控硬指标。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage3.md:6795:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage2.md:14872:- **High** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:170): eval 特征抽取和 probe v2 不完全同口径。probe v2 的 `/tmp/ae_feats.npz` 来源是 `POSE_TEST_FEAT=global + TEST.NECK_FEAT=after + pose_dict=None` 的 pose-OFF global BNNeck 特征；当前脚本只临时设 `pose_test_feat='global'`，但 `POSE_ENABLED=True` 时仍传 `pose_dict`，且不强制 `NECK_FEAT='after'`。如果要和 `94.43 / 73.36 / 63.82` 这组 probe v2 baseline 比，当前数字不可直接比较。要么强制 eval pose-off + after，要么先用当前 pose-on/before-or-after 口径重跑 baseline。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage3.md:6796:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage2.md:14874:- **Medium** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:129): CVaR 训练目标仍是 batch 内 P 类分类，默认 `IMS_PER_BATCH=64, K=4 => P=16`，没有 gallery distractor。前面 frozen smoke 已证明 N=16 episode loss 几乎为 0；last-stage 可能再次出现 `ss_ce/ss_cvar` 很小，导致 cvar≈random，不能真验机制。不是 runtime bug，但实验解释风险高。至少启动前应把 `ss_ce/ss_cvar/top-tail risk` 作为止损监控硬指标。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage3.md:12993:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage2.md:14851:- **High** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:170): eval 特征抽取和 probe v2 不完全同口径。probe v2 的 `/tmp/ae_feats.npz` 来源是 `POSE_TEST_FEAT=global + TEST.NECK_FEAT=after + pose_dict=None` 的 pose-OFF global BNNeck 特征；当前脚本只临时设 `pose_test_feat='global'`，但 `POSE_ENABLED=True` 时仍传 `pose_dict`，且不强制 `NECK_FEAT='after'`。如果要和 `94.43 / 73.36 / 63.82` 这组 probe v2 baseline 比，当前数字不可直接比较。要么强制 eval pose-off + after，要么先用当前 pose-on/before-or-after 口径重跑 baseline。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage3.md:12994:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage2.md:14872:- **High** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:170): eval 特征抽取和 probe v2 不完全同口径。probe v2 的 `/tmp/ae_feats.npz` 来源是 `POSE_TEST_FEAT=global + TEST.NECK_FEAT=after + pose_dict=None` 的 pose-OFF global BNNeck 特征；当前脚本只临时设 `pose_test_feat='global'`，但 `POSE_ENABLED=True` 时仍传 `pose_dict`，且不强制 `NECK_FEAT='after'`。如果要和 `94.43 / 73.36 / 63.82` 这组 probe v2 baseline 比，当前数字不可直接比较。要么强制 eval pose-off + after，要么先用当前 pose-on/before-or-after 口径重跑 baseline。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage3.md:16836:experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage.md:18989:- **Low** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:154): `call_project_loss` 捕获所有 `TypeError` 后静默降级，可能掩盖 loss 内部真实 bug。当前项目 `make_loss` 支持 `kp_data`，正常不会触发，但这里最好只做显式签名兼容或直接调用。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage3.md:16847:- **High** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:170): eval 特征抽取和 probe v2 不完全同口径。probe v2 的 `/tmp/ae_feats.npz` 来源是 `POSE_TEST_FEAT=global + TEST.NECK_FEAT=after + pose_dict=None` 的 pose-OFF global BNNeck 特征；当前脚本只临时设 `pose_test_feat='global'`，但 `POSE_ENABLED=True` 时仍传 `pose_dict`，且不强制 `NECK_FEAT='after'`。如果要和 `94.43 / 73.36 / 63.82` 这组 probe v2 baseline 比，当前数字不可直接比较。要么强制 eval pose-off + after，要么先用当前 pose-on/before-or-after 口径重跑 baseline。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage3.md:16849:- **Medium** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:129): CVaR 训练目标仍是 batch 内 P 类分类，默认 `IMS_PER_BATCH=64, K=4 => P=16`，没有 gallery distractor。前面 frozen smoke 已证明 N=16 episode loss 几乎为 0；last-stage 可能再次出现 `ss_ce/ss_cvar` 很小，导致 cvar≈random，不能真验机制。不是 runtime bug，但实验解释风险高。至少启动前应把 `ss_ce/ss_cvar/top-tail risk` 作为止损监控硬指标。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage3.md:16851:- **Medium** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:269): `ss_episode_loss` 在 AMP autocast 内运行，`F.normalize + einsum / tau + cross_entropy` 可能走半精度。默认 `tau=0.1` 正常大概率没事，但 collapse/近零范数时半精度 normalize 更容易出 NaN。更稳是 episode loss 内部显式用 `feat.float()` 或在该段禁用 autocast。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage3.md:16853:- **Low** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:90): 解冻 `base.stages[-1]` 没覆盖 Swin 的输出 `base.norm3`，它是在 `stages` 外注册的 LayerNorm。严格说这不是完整 last-stage 输出层 FT，但不会导致崩溃。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage3.md:16855:- **Low** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:232): random-support 的 mAP 是多 seed mean/std，但 `rand_f10` 只取 seed0。若 false10 要承担“gap 非 trivial”的证据，建议也报 random false10 mean/std。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage3.md:16857:- **Low** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:41): `alpha/tau/sampler` 缺少显式 guard。目标 config 下没问题；但 `alpha` 越界、`tau<=0`、或误用非 triplet sampler 会在 topk/loss 调用处才炸。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review_laststage3.md:19432:- **High** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:267): train 仍然在 `POSE_ENABLED=True` 时传入 `pose_dict`，而 eval 在 [line 183](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:183) 强制 `pose_dict=None / use_pose=False`。也就是说，`ss_episode_loss` 优化的是 pose-on/PSG 激活后的训练 descriptor，但诊断看的是 probe v2 的 pose-off global descriptor。这不是纯 runtime bug，但会让 last-stage 结果无法干净回答“CVaR 是否改善 probe v2 descriptor”。建议训练 forward 也强制 pose-off：即使 dataloader 返回 `pose_dict`，这里也调用 `model(img, ..., pose_dict=None)`，让 SS loss 和 eval descriptor 同口径。

    11	  对每 id 的 K 个 support risk 做 CVaR_α(worst tail); L = mean_CE + lam·mean_CVaR。

     8	class RandomIdentitySampler(Sampler):
     9	    """
    10	    Randomly sample N identities, then for each identity,
    11	    randomly sample K instances, therefore batch size is N*K.
    12	    Args:
    13	    - data_source (list): list of (img_path, pid, camid).
    14	    - num_instances (int): number of instances per identity in a batch.
    15	    - batch_size (int): number of examples in a batch.

    18	    def __init__(self, data_source, batch_size, num_instances):
    19	        self.data_source = data_source
    20	        self.batch_size = batch_size
    21	        self.num_instances = num_instances
    22	        self.num_pids_per_batch = self.batch_size // self.num_instances
    23	        self.index_dic = defaultdict(list) #dict with list value
    24	        #{783: [0, 5, 116, 876, 1554, 2041],...,}
    25	        for index, (_, pid, _, _) in enumerate(self.data_source):
    26	            self.index_dic[pid].append(index)
    27	        self.pids = list(self.index_dic.keys())
    28	
    29	        # estimate number of examples in an epoch
    30	        self.length = 0
    31	        for pid in self.pids:
    32	            idxs = self.index_dic[pid]
    33	            num = len(idxs)
    34	            if num < self.num_instances:
    35	                num = self.num_instances
    36	            self.length += num - num % self.num_instances
    37	
    38	    def __iter__(self):
    39	        batch_idxs_dict = defaultdict(list)
    40	
    41	        for pid in self.pids:
    42	            idxs = copy.deepcopy(self.index_dic[pid])
    43	            if len(idxs) < self.num_instances:
    44	                idxs = np.random.choice(idxs, size=self.num_instances, replace=True)
    45	            random.shuffle(idxs)
    46	            batch_idxs = []
    47	            for idx in idxs:

    49	                if len(batch_idxs) == self.num_instances:

    52

    54	        final_idxs = []

    60	                final_idxs.extend(batch_idxs)

    75	    Code imported from https://github.com/Cysu/open-reid/blob/master/reid/utils/data/sampler.py.

    81	    def __init__(self, data_source, num_instances):

    85	        for index, item in enumerate(data_source):
    86	            pid = item[1]

    91	    def __iter__(self):

    96	            t = self.index_dic[pid]
    97	            replace = False if len(t) >= self.num_instances else True

    99	            ret.extend(t)

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:1648:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9306:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:5830:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2155:./ondisk_pivot.md:4402:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:1671:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9329:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7886:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1888:./reviews/deep_25.md:14099:3. **机制怎么长出来**：MFE 先在 ViT patch 上做 intra-patch 和 inter-patch 编码，补足 patch 内外层级信息。PPM 不做 pose-to-global，而是把 pose 和 patch 当成两种模态，用 Mahalanobis distance 加 cosine similarity 建 pose-patch 相似矩阵，只保留高置信关键点对应的 patch，从而降低局部 pose 错误的全局污染。TAD 再用 context extraction layer 和 texture extraction layer，以 PPM 过滤后的 pose 特征为约束，通过 cross-attention 强化可区分纹理。pose loss 还约束人体和非人体映射特征不要太相似。机制和两个失败场景绑定得比较紧。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:1904:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9562:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17929:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4400:./reassess/r_3.md:4482:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:21:"mechanism": "TTPM is a ViT + HRNet pipeline with three parts and no occlusion-sample augmentation. A Multi-patch Feature Encoder encodes intra-patch and inter-patch features (re-grouping patches at 2x scale with the cls token). Pose-Patch Mapping (PPM) builds a fine-grained, per-patch positional correspondence between M pose keypoints and N patches via a learned similarity S = gamma*D_M - eta*S_M that combines an affine-extended Mahalanobis distance and affine-extended cosine similarity, gates out low-confidence keypoints by a heatmap-confidence threshold, and selects the argmax-similarity patch per keypoint, thereby down-weighting occluded patches without coarse global pose mapping. A Texture-Aware Decoder (context-extraction MHSA layers + texture-extraction MHCA layers using pose-filtered features as queries) leverages texture distinctiveness to separate the target from non-target pedestrian occluders. An auxiliary pose loss penalizes high cosine similarity between human-part and non-human (background) features.",
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:1905:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9563:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17930:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4401:./reassess/r_3.md:4483:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:22:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas for occluded ReID. (1) The pose loss L_p that explicitly minimizes cosine similarity between body-part features and non-human/background features — a cheap regularizer to suppress occluder/background leakage into the identity embedding, applicable to any pose- or part-based occluded model. (2) The texture-distinctiveness decoder channel aimed specifically at non-target PEDESTRIAN occlusion: when the occluder is itself a person, pose/structure cues fail (same skeleton topology), so using texture appearance distinctiveness (via pose-filtered queries cross-attending to contextual features) to push apart target vs distractor-person is a concrete mechanism for the under-addressed person-on-person occlusion case. Also transferable: replacing coarse pose-to-global mapping with a per-keypoint-to-patch confidence-gated argmax correspondence (Mahalanobis+cosine affine similarity) to localize visible regions.",

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:4147:  1648	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9306:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:5830:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2155:./ondisk_pivot.md:4402:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:4170:  1671	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9329:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7886:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1888:./reviews/deep_25.md:14099:3. **机制怎么长出来**：MFE 先在 ViT patch 上做 intra-patch 和 inter-patch 编码，补足 patch 内外层级信息。PPM 不做 pose-to-global，而是把 pose 和 patch 当成两种模态，用 Mahalanobis distance 加 cosine similarity 建 pose-patch 相似矩阵，只保留高置信关键点对应的 patch，从而降低局部 pose 错误的全局污染。TAD 再用 context extraction layer 和 texture extraction layer，以 PPM 过滤后的 pose 特征为约束，通过 cross-attention 强化可区分纹理。pose loss 还约束人体和非人体映射特征不要太相似。机制和两个失败场景绑定得比较紧。

A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:4403:  1904	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9562:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17929:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4400:./reassess/r_3.md:4482:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:21:"mechanism": "TTPM is a ViT + HRNet pipeline with three parts and no occlusion-sample augmentation. A Multi-patch Feature Encoder encodes intra-patch and inter-patch features (re-grouping patches at 2x scale with the cls token). Pose-Patch Mapping (PPM) builds a fine-grained, per-patch positional correspondence between M pose keypoints and N patches via a learned similarity S = gamma*D_M - eta*S_M that combines an affine-extended Mahalanobis distance and affine-extended cosine similarity, gates out low-confidence keypoints by a heatmap-confidence threshold, and selects the argmax-similarity patch per keypoint, thereby down-weighting occluded patches without coarse global pose mapping. A Texture-Aware Decoder (context-extraction MHSA layers + texture-extraction MHCA layers using pose-filtered features as queries) leverages texture distinctiveness to separate the target from non-target pedestrian occluders. An auxiliary pose loss penalizes high cosine similarity between human-part and non-human (background) features.",
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:4404:  1905	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9563:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17930:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4401:./reassess/r_3.md:4483:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:22:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas for occluded ReID. (1) The pose loss L_p that explicitly minimizes cosine similarity between body-part features and non-human/background features — a cheap regularizer to suppress occluder/background leakage into the identity embedding, applicable to any pose- or part-based occluded model. (2) The texture-distinctiveness decoder channel aimed specifically at non-target PEDESTRIAN occlusion: when the occluder is itself a person, pose/structure cues fail (same skeleton topology), so using texture appearance distinctiveness (via pose-filtered queries cross-attending to contextual features) to push apart target vs distractor-person is a concrete mechanism for the under-addressed person-on-person occlusion case. Also transferable: replacing coarse pose-to-global mapping with a per-keypoint-to-patch confidence-gated argmax correspondence (Mahalanobis+cosine affine similarity) to localize visible regions.",

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:4421:  1922	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9580:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17999:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4650:./reassess/r_3.md:7994:./reassess/r_3.md:4482:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:21:"mechanism": "TTPM is a ViT + HRNet pipeline with three parts and no occlusion-sample augmentation. A Multi-patch Feature Encoder encodes intra-patch and inter-patch features (re-grouping patches at 2x scale with the cls token). Pose-Patch Mapping (PPM) builds a fine-grained, per-patch positional correspondence between M pose keypoints and N patches via a learned similarity S = gamma*D_M - eta*S_M that combines an affine-extended Mahalanobis distance and affine-extended cosine similarity, gates out low-confidence keypoints by a heatmap-confidence threshold, and selects the argmax-similarity patch per keypoint, thereby down-weighting occluded patches without coarse global pose mapping. A Texture-Aware Decoder (context-extraction MHSA layers + texture-extraction MHCA layers using pose-filtered features as queries) leverages texture distinctiveness to separate the target from non-target pedestrian occluders. An auxiliary pose loss penalizes high cosine similarity between human-part and non-human (background) features.",

A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:5343:./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:9:exp260b 已有 OA-SD（occluded student ↔ clean EMA teacher 双前向）+ PLBOA（下肢遮挡增广），但其蒸馏只作用在 **pooled global 特征**（cosine）。BT-PKD 进一步蒸馏 per-keypoint 特征**方向**（cosine），仍是「让被遮挡 token 的特征向 clean token 看齐」。两者都没有触碰探针指认的真正病灶：**被遮挡 per-part token 的归一化统计（一阶/二阶矩）整体漂移到一个可分离的子空间**——这是一条「有/无遮挡」的 domain 轴，叠加在身份信号上。OA-SD/BT-PKD 把个体特征拉近，但没有显式消掉这条 domain 轴；探针显示这条轴在跨域时大量残留（pre-GCN AUC 0.97），GCN 只部分修复。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:5368:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:325:experiments/decisions.md:4592:**结果**: VC-Norm vs control 跨域全变体 −3.3 mAP(global 77.3/80.6, part_only 79.3/82.7, equal_concat 77.5/80.9)。**VC-Norm 在真遮挡跨域上显著伤**(Market 学的对齐 transform 跨域误用)。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:7247:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:7235:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:9:exp260b 已有 OA-SD（occluded student ↔ clean EMA teacher 双前向）+ PLBOA（下肢遮挡增广），但其蒸馏只作用在 **pooled global 特征**（cosine）。BT-PKD 进一步蒸馏 per-keypoint 特征**方向**（cosine），仍是「让被遮挡 token 的特征向 clean token 看齐」。两者都没有触碰探针指认的真正病灶：**被遮挡 per-part token 的归一化统计（一阶/二阶矩）整体漂移到一个可分离的子空间**——这是一条「有/无遮挡」的 domain 轴，叠加在身份信号上。OA-SD/BT-PKD 把个体特征拉近，但没有显式消掉这条 domain 轴；探针显示这条轴在跨域时大量残留（pre-GCN AUC 0.97），GCN 只部分修复。

   114	def msmt17_split(data_root, list_file):
   115	    """MSMT17 list-file split: each line 'relpath pid'; cam parsed from filename
   116	    (pid_seq_CAM_time_...), images under <data_root>/MSMT17/test/<relpath>."""
   117	    items = []
   118	    base = os.path.join(data_root, 'MSMT17')
   119	    with open(os.path.join(base, list_file)) as f:
   120	        for line in f:
   121	            rel, pid = line.strip().split(' ')
   122	            cam = int(os.path.basename(rel).split('_')[2]) - 1
   123	            items.append((os.path.join(base, 'test', rel), int(pid), cam))
   124	    return items

    40	def _extract_feat_flip(model, img, pose_dict, camids, target_view, use_pose, flip_test):
    41	    """Forward once (default) or twice with horizontal flip, return averaged feature.
    42	
    43	    When `flip_test=True`, features of original and flipped batch are averaged.
    44	    Used by both mid-training eval and do_inference. MaxSim post-hoc eval stays
    45	    in `scripts/eval_fliptest_maxsim.py` and is NOT invoked here.
    46	
    47	    Fused-feature averaging requires **per-block L2-renorm** to preserve the
    48	    equal_concat semantics: model output `[g_norm | p1_norm | ... | pN_norm]`
    49	    has each block unit-norm; whole-vector averaging followed by a single global
    50	    L2-normalize distorts the per-block weights (blocks with high flip-invariance
    51	    get amplified, blocks with low flip-invariance get attenuated). The fix
    52	    detects `equal_concat` via `model.pose_test_feat` and re-normalizes each
    53	    C-dim block after averaging.
    54	
    55	    Output handling:
    56	    - Tensor `feat` in `equal_concat` mode: split into (B, n_blocks, C), average,
    57	      F.normalize per block, reshape back. Preserves equal-weight cosine fusion.
    58	    - Tensor `feat` in `global` / `gcn_only` / `part_only` (single block) modes:
    59	      straight `(feat + feat_flip) / 2` — whole-vector renorm downstream is
    60	      exactly correct for single block.
    61	    - Tensor `feat` in `concat_scaled`: straight average (scale factors baked
    62	      in by the model; whole-vector renorm downstream preserves relative weights).
    63	    - Dict `feat` (cvk_* / maxsim* modes): average each field, then L2-renorm
    64	      `global_feat` (dim=1) and `kp_feats` (dim=2) for downstream correctness.
    65	    """
    66	    if use_pose:
    67	        feat, _ = model(img, cam_label=camids, view_label=target_view, pose_dict=pose_dict)
    68	    else:
    69	        feat, _ = model(img, cam_label=camids, view_label=target_view)
    70	    if not flip_test:
    71	        return feat
    72	    img_f, pose_f = flip_batch(img, pose_dict if use_pose else None)
    73	    if use_pose:
    74	        feat_f, _ = model(img_f, cam_label=camids, view_label=target_view, pose_dict=pose_f)
    75	    else:
    76	        feat_f, _ = model(img_f, cam_label=camids, view_label=target_view)
    77	
    78	    if isinstance(feat, dict) and isinstance(feat_f, dict):
    79	        merged = dict(feat)
    80	        for k in ('global_feat', 'kp_feats', 'kp_weights'):
    81	            if k in feat and k in feat_f and isinstance(feat[k], torch.Tensor):
    82	                merged[k] = (feat[k] + feat_f[k]) / 2.0
    83	        # Re-normalize averaged feature blocks for MaxSim/CVK-style downstream
    84	        # (they expect unit-norm global/kp; maxsim script also does this post-hoc).
    85	        if 'global_feat' in merged and merged['global_feat'].dim() == 2:
    86	            merged['global_feat'] = F.normalize(merged['global_feat'], p=2, dim=1)
    87	        if 'kp_feats' in merged and merged['kp_feats'].dim() == 3:
    88	            merged['kp_feats'] = F.normalize(merged['kp_feats'], p=2, dim=2)

Verdict: **approve**

未发现阻断训练的 Critical/High 残留 bug，可以跑 backbone last-stage 训练。前轮几个关键点已修到位：

- `make_optimizer(cfg, model, center_criterion)` + `create_scheduler(cfg, optimizer)` 接口正确。
- train 已强制 `pose_dict=None`，eval 也用 `_extract_feat_flip(..., use_pose=False)`，pose-on/list-loss 干扰已消除。
- `ss_episode_loss` 的 3 mode 逻辑正确：`plain=base`，`random=base+ss_ce`，`cvar=base+ss_ce+lam*cvar`。
- AMP 下 `feat.float()` 再 normalize，`K/alpha/tau` 和 batch 分组 guard 都在。
- eval single-support diagnostic 基本复用 probe v2：common valid query、distractor 全量、random mean/std、best/worst oracle、false10 都有。

**Findings**

- **Medium / 非阻断口径风险**: [ss_cvar_laststage.py:283](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:283) 的 SS-CVaR loss 用的是训练 forward 返回的 `global_feat`，而 [pose_backbone_model.py:1088](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/model/pose_backbone_model.py:1088) 这里返回的是 BNNeck 前特征；eval probe v2 是 `TEST.NECK_FEAT=after` 的 BNNeck 后特征。项目 baseline triplet 本来也是 pre-BN 训练、after-BN eval，所以不算阻断 bug，但严格说不是“直接优化 probe descriptor”。结果解释时要写成：优化 pose-off global backbone feature，诊断 after-BN global descriptor。

- **Low / monitor risk**: [ss_cvar_laststage.py:264](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:264) `model.train()` 后只把 frozen BN 设 eval，冻结的早期 Swin stage 里的 DropPath 仍是 train-mode 随机。三组 `plain/random/cvar` 都共享这个条件，比较公平；但它不是完全 deterministic frozen lower backbone。若 loss 抖动异常，再考虑把 frozen stages 显式 eval。

- **Low / usability**: [ss_cvar_laststage.py:248](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:248) 固定 `set_seed(1234)`，不会吃 `cfg.SOLVER.SEED`。首轮三 mode 同 seed 对照没问题；后面多 seed 要补参数或改成读取 config。

结论：**可以启动 cvar/random/plain 三组 last-stage backbone 训练**。启动后重点盯 `ss_ce/ss_cvar`：如果前几 epoch 很快接近 0，说明又复现 frozen N=16 的 episode 太易空转，应及时止损或增大 episode 难度。
